summary: Carlyle Credit Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K covering three items. Item 3.02 reports the issuance of 322,258 shares of Class I common stock for $5.9 million in aggregate consideration on June 1, 2026, with final share determination on June 17, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. Item 7.01 discloses a $0.14 per share dividend payable July 29, 2026, to holders of record June 30, 2026, with possible reinvestment. Item 8.01 states net asset value per share of $18.20 as of May 31, 2026, and aggregate net asset value of approximately $1.7 billion. This is a routine continuous offering of unregistered shares; no special-situation transaction is present.
